latestVersion.changelog:
- Added support for setting a specific password during the "reset-password" action (`--password` argument).
- Documentation updated to show that "reset-password" can now accept a custom password in addition to generating a random one.
- Updated installation instructions to clone the application code from GitHub at release tag `v2.1.0` (was `v1.0.10` previously).
